reference_sql:
SELECT dayname(order_date) AS weekday,
       SUM(units) AS units
FROM sales
GROUP BY 1
alternatives: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%A') AS weekday, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY strftime(order_date, '%A')

SELECT CASE isodow(order_date) WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS weekday, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT CASE isodow(order_date) WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS weekday, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: A CASE on isodow spells out each name and needs no name function, but it is far longer to write.
